claims.text: The quality of the data is evaluated using BLEU scores, which provide a normalized quality score for translations.
Sanity checks are applied to ensure the quality of professional translations, and low-scoring samples are manually inspected.
The evaluation also considers model output variance across different speakers to assess stability and quality.
